title: Labels
description: Labels of the data set, and per-file state. Written by the app.

filename.description: Audio file path relative to dataset-root, using forward slashes

dataset-root.description: The entry in the project's dataset-roots which contains the file. Absent in older label files, where filename was relative to the working directory

version.description: Format version. Version 1 files have no version field. Version 3 added label states, scores and channels.

stop_s.description: Label stop time in seconds. Equal to start_s for an onset.

state.description: Absent for a label. suggested: proposed (eg. by a detector) and waiting for review. rejected: proposed, then judged not to be an event.

score.description: The proposer's confidence, if it gave one

class-id.description: Class identifier for the label class

class-name.description: Class name included for readability / processing: The class-id should be considered authoritative

files.description: State of files that differ from the default of todo with nothing cached

status.description: todo: not fully labelled. done: fully labelled, so with no labels it contains none of the classes. skip: not usable.

source-id.description: 12 hex digits of a 64-bit FNV-1a hash of the file's contents

size.description: File size in bytes when source-id was computed

channel.description: Channel to view and play, numbered from 1, or mix. Overrides the project's channel.

mtime.description: Modification time when source-id was computed, in seconds of the platform's file clock

export.description: The most recent clip export of this file

verified.description: Every clip was read back and matched
